menus.name: Four-course dinner menu
menus.note: Wednesday to Friday; dishes chosen from the evening menu; extra courses DKK 450

menus.name: Three-course lunch menu
menus.note: Thursday to Saturday, with snacks; pairing DKK 750 for three half glasses or DKK 1,500 for full glasses

menus.name: Four-course lunch menu
menus.note: Thursday to Saturday, with snacks; pairing DKK 1,000 for half glasses or DKK 2,000 for full glasses

bookingOpens: By phone or email only (info@hennekirkebykro.dk); there is no online booking. Tables and rooms for the coming season can be booked at any time of year. The 2026 season ends on 19 December; the 2027 season runs from the evening of 5 March to 30 October.
bookingPhone: +45 75 25 54 00, Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday 9am to 3pm, Tuesday 9am to 1pm
waitlist: When a date is full, the booking manager can put guests on a waiting list with their preferred dates and alternatives.
